$comment: Dependency-closure policy for Constitution Article III (core is headless and model-agnostic) and Article IX (plugins own domains). Enforced by tools/boundaries.mjs and covered by tests/boundaries-core.test.mjs.

core.rationale: core, parser, registry, runtime, trace, readiness, authoring: no renderer, domain, model provider, TTS, or media implementation.

compatibility.rationale: Compatibility producers adapt a dialect into core contracts; they must not import plugins.

plugin.rationale: Plugins own domain state and may share plugin-to-plugin helper contracts, but never hosts.

example.rationale: Host applications compose everything. Nothing may depend on an example.

externalDependencyPolicy.note: Core may use general-purpose runtime dependencies; it may not reach for a renderer, map, provider, speech, media, DOM, or chess implementation. Plugins and examples are unrestricted for external dependencies.
